name: 宇宙与位面
intro: 西幻宇宙不是「三界六道」，而是一条从上到下的「存在之链」加若干并行的彼岸。本库默认：凡世居中，上有天界、下有地狱与冥界，旁有妖精国度与梦境，四周是元素界，最外是以太之海与虚空。具体剧可只取其中几层。

entries.name: 存在之链
entries.summary: 欧洲中世纪至文艺复兴的宇宙秩序观：一切存在从高到低排成一条链——神、天使、人、动物、植物、矿物。每一环有固定的位置，越级被视为僭越。本库用它统一位面与种族的上下关系。

xianxia.note: 差异：存在之链是「秩序与位格」的阶梯，不讲轮回；越级的冲动（人想成神、天使想做人）本身就是西方戏剧的核心冲突。

details.本库链序: 以太（神）→ 天界存在 → 妖精与长生种 → 人与凡人诸族 → 变形者与诅咒者 → 野兽 → 亡灵 → 深渊存在
details.链外: 元素生灵与龙——比链更古老

entries.visual: 可作为片头或设定图的竖向阶梯意象。

references.work: 中世纪与文艺复兴哲学

image.brief: A tall vertical ladder of being rising through the sky: at the bottom rough stones and crystals, above them plants and trees, then animals, then human figures, then winged angelic figures among clouds, and at the very top a sourceless radiant light; each level stands on its own golden step of a single great chain linking them all from bottom to top.

entries.name: 凡世
entries.summary: 凡人居住的世界：王国、森林、山脉与海洋。各界在这里交汇，所以所有存在都想进入或控制它。

details.与他界的通道: 地脉交汇的圣地、巨石圈、坟场、镜子、梦

entries.visual: 写实的中世纪欧洲风景。

references.note: Midgard 中庭（只取「居中之界」意象）

image.brief: A wide sweeping view of a medieval European-style kingdom: a walled stone town with a castle on a hill above a river valley, patchwork farmland, a dark forest on one side and snowy mountains far behind, morning light breaking through clouds; tiny figures on a road for scale.

entries.name: 天界
entries.summary: 天使与圣光的居所：一层层向上的光之领域，越高越纯、越难以凡躯进入。只有圣徒的灵魂与被召见者能到达。

details.层级: 七重天（取古代宇宙论的同心天球意象），最高为至高天 Empyrean
details.规则: 凡人无法以肉身停留；时间近乎静止

entries.visual: 层层叠起的光之平台、白金色云海、巨大而简洁的建筑。

image.brief: A vast celestial realm of tiered radiant terraces rising upward through layers of white-gold cloud, enormous minimalist white stone arches and colonnades glowing from within, beams of light descending between the tiers, tiny winged figures in the far distance for scale; serene, luminous, immense. No religious symbols.

entries.name: 地狱
entries.summary: 恶魔的国度：一层层向下的环形深渊，每一层惩罚一种罪，由一位恶魔君王统治。灵魂是这里的货币。

details.层级: 九层环狱（取但丁地狱的漏斗结构），越深越冷、越接近最初的堕落者
details.规则: 契约即法律；灵魂可交易

entries.visual: 漏斗状的巨大深坑、熔岩河、黑曜石城堡，最底层反而是冰。

references.note: 九层地狱与冰封的最底层

image.brief: An immense funnel-shaped abyss descending in concentric terraced rings into darkness, rivers of molten lava flowing down the rings, jagged black obsidian fortresses on the ledges, ash falling like snow, and at the very bottom a faint glimpse of a frozen pale-blue lake of ice; tiny winged silhouettes for scale.

entries.name: 冥界
entries.summary: 死者之地：灵魂渡过冥河，由冥界判官审判后去往安息之野、至福之地或深渊。本库默认死者安息、不轮回；未安息的亡灵就是没能渡河的灵魂。

xianxia.note: 希腊冥界也有判官（米诺斯、拉达曼提斯、埃阿科斯）与分途；柏拉图厄尔神话里灵魂喝遗忘河水后转世，凯撒记载德鲁伊信灵魂转生——采用剧可打开「转生」模块。

details.入口: 冥河与摆渡人（死者口含一枚硬币作船资）
details.审判: 三位判官，分去安息之野、至福之地或深渊
details.规则: 喝下遗忘之河的水即忘记生前；活人进入需付出巨大代价
details.可选模块: 转生（厄尔神话 / 德鲁伊的灵魂转生）

entries.visual: 灰色的河、雾、无色的平原与渡船。

references.note: 三判官：拉达曼提斯审亚洲来者、埃阿科斯审欧洲来者、米诺斯终审

references.work: 柏拉图《理想国》厄尔神话

references.note: 德鲁伊：灵魂不灭、死后转入他人身体

image.brief: A colorless grey underworld landscape: a wide slow black river under a sunless pale sky, thick mist drifting on the water, a lone hooded ferryman poling a long flat wooden boat carrying a few faint translucent figures toward a distant shore of grey asphodel-like flowers, silhouettes of bare trees; hushed, melancholic, timeless.

entries.name: 妖精国度
entries.summary: 与凡世并行的妖精之地：永恒的黄昏或盛夏、过于鲜艳的色彩。一夜等于凡世百年，吃了这里的食物就回不去。

xianxia.concept: 洞天福地 / 仙境（参照）
xianxia.note: 「山中方一日，世上已千年」在西方有完全对应的凯尔特传说。

details.入口: 仙女环（蘑菇圈）、古墓丘、雾、特定节日的夜晚
details.规则: 时间流速不同；不可吃喝；不可说出真名；冷铁失效之地

entries.visual: 饱和而柔和的色彩、发光的植物、永不落下的黄昏。

references.note: Tír na nÓg、仙丘与时间流速

image.brief: An enchanted otherworldly forest glade at eternal dusk: impossibly vivid violet and gold sky, giant ancient trees with faintly glowing silver bark, luminous flowers and mushrooms forming a perfect ring on soft moss, floating motes of light, a shimmering mist-veiled archway of woven branches in the background; dreamlike, beautiful, slightly unsettling.

entries.name: 元素界
entries.summary: 火、水、土、风四大元素的本源之地，元素生灵的故乡。在边界处元素彼此交融（熔岩海、雷雨云、冰川）。

xianxia.concept: 五行本源 / 元素秘境（参照）

details.四界: 永燃之火域、无底之海、无尽之岩、无地之风
details.规则: 凡人需元素护符才能生存

entries.visual: 单一元素铺满整个视野的世界。

references.work: 古典四元素说与帕拉塞尔苏斯

image.brief: A surreal elemental realm where four zones meet at a central point: on the left an endless sea of fire and flowing lava, on the right a deep churning ocean rising as a wall of water, below a landscape of floating crystal-veined rock islands, and above a vast sky of swirling storm winds and lightning; a tiny figure on a rock at the center for scale.

entries.name: 以太之海
entries.summary: 诸界之间的星光之海：以太构成，神与传说者的灵魂在此航行。法师灵魂出窍到极远处便会抵达这里。

details.规则: 思想即方向；肉身无法进入，只能灵魂航行

entries.visual: 深蓝与虹彩的星云之海，漂浮着岛屿般的遗迹。

relations.role: 神与传说者的灵魂所在

image.brief: An infinite sea of starlight and iridescent nebula clouds in deep blue, violet and silver, with ancient ruined stone islands and broken colonnades floating in it, streams of glowing aether flowing between them like currents, a tiny translucent silver figure drifting toward the nearest island for scale.

entries.name: 外域虚空
entries.summary: 一切秩序之外的黑暗：没有元素、没有光、没有名字。那里的存在不属于存在之链，接触它们会使人疯狂。

details.规则: 无法被理解；常规魔法与圣光对其效果不稳定

entries.visual: 绝对的黑暗中隐约可见难以名状的巨大轮廓。

references.note: 不可名状之物（只借类型）

image.brief: An almost totally black void with a faint thin edge of a starry realm at the bottom of the frame, and in the darkness above an immense barely visible shape of impossible geometry outlined only by a dim sickly violet glow, suggesting tentacle-like and angular forms without clear definition; a tiny human silhouette on the star edge for scale. Dread, vastness.

entries.name: 梦境
entries.summary: 所有凡人梦境相连的地方：先知、灵魂术士与高阶法师可以有意识地进入，进入他人的梦、在梦中会面或施加噩梦。

xianxia.concept: 梦道 / 入梦之术（参照）

details.规则: 在梦中受的伤会留在醒来的身体上（可选规则）；梦魇生物栖居其中

entries.visual: 不合逻辑地拼接的场景、颠倒的楼梯、柔和失焦的光。

image.brief: A soft-focus dreamscape in pastel haze: a spiral staircase rises from a field of tall glowing grass into the clouds and the same staircase also hangs upside down from the clouds above, a doorway standing alone in the grass, a bedroom window floating in midair, a huge pale moon close to the ground; everything slightly blurred like a dream; a tiny figure in a nightgown on the stairs for scale.

entries.name: 地脉与圣地
entries.summary: 大地之下流动的力量之脉，交汇处便是圣地：巨石圈、圣泉、古墓丘、大教堂都建在交汇点上。以太晶在这里生长，各界的门也在这里最薄。

xianxia.concept: 灵脉 / 洞天福地（参照）

details.类型: 巨石圈、圣泉与圣井、古墓丘、山顶修道院
details.规则: 在交汇点施法增强；圣地之争是王国、教会与德鲁伊冲突的根源

entries.visual: 地面隐约发光的线条汇向一圈立石。

references.work: 英国 ley line 说法（20 世纪）与巨石遗迹

image.brief: A circle of tall ancient standing stones on a windswept grassy hilltop at twilight, faint glowing silver-blue lines running through the grass from several directions and converging at the center of the circle, a soft column of light rising from the center into the clouds, distant rolling hills; tiny figure at the edge for scale.
